title: Bloodlines

poet_identity.adult: The same Black male Poet throughout: deep dark-brown skin, low faded haircut, neat full beard and moustache.
poet_identity.01_03: Plain black T-shirt, dark trousers, plain dark sneakers; no sunglasses.
poet_identity.04_14: Black tracksuit with thin red piping, black Chelsea boots; sunglasses are a separate component.
poet_identity.young: Young Poet is the same character as a Black boy.
poet_identity.double_and_soul: The double and soul keep the Poet identity; they are instances or special treatments of him.
poet_identity.other_roles: Women and other men are separately labeled supporting roles, never substitutes for the Poet.

limits: Labeled raster concept/production-reference sheets with visually separated components, not individual transparent PNG exports.
Artwork was visually checked for identity, component classes and separation. Print scale, crop boundaries and exact pivot coordinates are not calibrated.
Main-pose and overview figures demonstrate assembly; use the detached working parts for construction.
Cut or mask parts, align the same-view pivots, set layer order and test motion before production.
Effects described as coded in the treatment are represented by visual elements/instructions; no animation engine or coded effect is implemented in these packs.

qa_notes: Floor repaired to plain black without baked lamp reflections; mesh, posts, rails and lights separate.
Seven loose node dot cards are drawn; duplicate any one for an eight-node animation. Node count label is illustrative.
Disc and rim are separate; calibrate a common centre before rotation.
Emblem is a proposed design. For a round floating star in the staff cage, use the orb from05.props.star-names rather than the alternate pointed insert.
Use the nine named/blank plates from05.props.star-names for joist names; the extra grade-stamp icon is optional.
All nine canonical names are now present: AMOS, IDA, OTIS, RUTH, MAE, ELI, CORA, SOL, JUNE. The registered KIN vector supplement supplies exact placement and connectivity.
Two cinderblock courses and plain night window backing repaired; joist nameplates and exact graph are separate.
Sky, horizon, distant gate, rise, grass and globe floor detached; no parade or named graph baked in.
Solid leaves and feather-rib open replacements independently cut; exact KIN veining supplied separately. Calibrate replacement contours and hinges in rig assembly.

information.identity_lock: Adult dark-brown Black MALE Poet, short fade, full groomed beard. Black short-sleeve T-shirt/no glasses01-03; red-piped black tracksuit/Chelsea boots/detachable sunglasses04-14. EX male is rear-only. Young Poet is the same lineage Black boy.
assembly_notes: Working body parts are separate: waist-length armless torso, independent hip connector/rear seat, single upper/lower limbs, hands and feet. Main-pose pages and marked proof bands are assembly references.

Master overview is identity reference only. Corrected separated core and action cards govern assembly. Painted heads in legacy action sheets are expression references; use blank heads and separate features from the core.
Core anchor pattern and the root assembly guide govern pivot placement. Generic prop samples on action pages are references; source-specific root prop sheets are authoritative.

view_limits: Nine source names are canonical; most ages, gender embodiments, individual facial designs and white/indigo wardrobe assignments are visual design choices. Mae is explicitly a named woman with a distinctive gold accent.
Head working views are front/profile/back; face overlays are frontal and require placement for profile use.
The fixed reference lineup follows KIN array order; source claim choreography follows the separate claim_order.
Assembled proof board is separate from the working component sheets; props depicted there are pose cues, with independent props supplied by root.
information.mechanical_status: Every torso and limb segment is separated. Hip bridge has one waist and two leg pivots with independent rear seat and lower-robe overlays. Raster images require crop/scale/pivot registration, not rig-ready geometry.
information.protagonist_continuity: Poet cameo is dark-brown Black MALE, short fade/full neat beard, red-piped black tracksuit and sunglasses.

assembly_notes: Use the exact shared KIN graph and nameplates; scenery contains no invented named constellation.
Use root mattress-pad edge/top cards in basement; warm bulb, stars and raking light remain independent.
